core_principles: Elite-tier Trading Terminal: Data density over whitespace.
Grid Borders Strategy: Expose the skeleton, 1px subtle borders on right/bottom.
Monospaced Precision: All data, numbers, and tags must use monospaced fonts for tabular alignment.
Context-Aware UI: Progressive disclosure of secondary metrics via hover states and tooltips.

layout_spacing.borders: border-collapse style layout, sharp edges (rounded-none or max rounded-sm)

surface_strategies.panels: Grid Borders: flat background, 1px subtle border, no shadow. Hover: slight border color darkening.
surface_strategies.headers: Solid Background with a hard bottom border (#1F1F1F), z-50 fixed or sticky.

components.navigation: Top or left vertical ticker/nav bar, dense and functional.
components.deal_universe_table: Shadcn Table, heavily customized. Tabular lining, monospaced numbers. Custom scrollbar.
components.deal_health_gauge: Custom SVG or react-gauge-chart with Red/Amber/Green zones.
components.spread_chart: Recharts AreaChart or LineChart with confidence bands (shaded areas).
components.force_directed_graph: react-force-graph-2d or d3.js with dark background and neon nodes (cyan, green, red depending on entity type).
components.what_if_sandbox: Shadcn Slider and Input. Very clinical, raw numeric readouts.
components.status_indicators: LED-style blinking dots (Signal Green/Red/Amber) alongside text.

motion_interactions.hover_states: Crisp background transitions (0.15s), border brightens slightly.
motion_interactions.loading: Terminal-style ASCII loaders or cursor blinking.
motion_interactions.transitions: Instant or very fast (0.1s). Avoid sluggish, overly animated transitions.

image_urls.description: City skyline with illuminated skyscrapers at night. Use with heavy black overlay for portfolio/dashboard empty states.

accessibility_testing.testing_attributes: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid
accessibility_testing.contrast: APCA contrast compliant. Ensure neon signals over dark backgrounds are legible.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly adhere to the dark terminal look. NO generic SaaS vibes.
Use JetBrains Mono or Roboto Mono for ALL numeric data points, tickers, and table cells.
Implement the Force-Directed Graph using react-force-graph-2d or D3 to map the deal ecosystem.
Spread chart needs shaded confidence bands (use Recharts Area chart overlaid with Line).
Borders must be sharp. Override Shadcn card radius to `rounded-none` or `rounded-sm`. Implement strict 1px grid borders.
